stage1.impression: A strong idea, a red acrylic record player on a walnut and brass credenza with a big coloured shadow climbing the wall, but the hero is nearly black: the plinth and platter sink into the dark wood while the plain pale wall and the shadow take the eye. The walnut and the brass fluting are soft and smeared, the wall has no surface, and the red slab cut off at the left reads as a mystery box, not a loudspeaker. It reads as a careful CG render, not a photograph.

blocking_9: The record player is the brightest, most legible thing in the frame: plinth/platter region lum_median >= 30 (now 12.7) while the wall stays <= 170, and the light through the acrylic reads as glowing red edges, not black
The tinted acrylic casts a visible red pool of light onto the walnut top beside and behind it
The walnut grain and the brass flutes show crisp real-scale texture with no denoiser smear at 100%
The loudspeaker reads as a loudspeaker (its horn silhouette visible), not a cropped red box at the frame edge
The wall has real plaster micro-texture; the wall shadow supports the product instead of being the largest shape in the frame
Clean render: no blotchy noise or smeared highlights in the acrylic or the brass

defects.what: Hero underexposed: lum_median 12.7, plinth lower half median 8.4, crush 10%; the acrylic reads as dark glass, colour barely visible
Huge soft red-grey shadow of the out-of-frame horn dominates the wall and competes with the product; its source is not readable
Loudspeaker cropped to a sliver: reads as an unidentified red box with a slot, not as the $20,000 horn
Walnut top and edge soft and low-resolution (2k asset at close range); top is dark (lum_median ~20) with no red light cast from the acrylic
Brass flutes have wobbly, smeared highlights typical of denoising at low samples
Wall is flat paint with no micro-texture (lum_range 23 over 450x350 px), reads as CG
Platter/record surface is a dull grey sheen with blotchy reflections, no crisp groove or specular line
Tonearm and counterweight edge soft (10-90 width 16 px) although near the focus plane

changes.problem: The record player is the darkest object in the frame instead of the brightest.

evidence.measured: lum_median 12.7, lum_p95 80.5, crush 8.3%; plinth band [470,560,1230,720] median 8.4 vs wall median 158

change.from: area 1.6 x 1.2 m, orbit az 35 el 15 d 2.2, irradiance 0.35
change.to: area 1.2 x 0.9 m softbox as a key, orbit az -25 el 35 d 1.6, irradiance 1.6, colour #FFF4E6, target the platter [0.36, 0.40, 0.77]

changes.expected: Plinth and platter lift to a mid-tone; the acrylic edges glow red; the platter top picks up a long soft specular stripe.

changes.problem: The sun skims in so low that it throws the horn's shadow over the whole wall and puts no light through the record player onto the walnut.

evidence.measured: walnut top beside the player lum_median 18.7, r_median 34: no red transmitted light; wall shadow spans ~900 px wide

changes.expected: A shorter wall shadow, and a sharp pool of red light cast through the plinth onto the walnut to the right of the player.

changes.problem: The loudspeaker is cropped to a 135 px red sliver and reads as an unidentified box.

evidence.measured: seen: a flat red slab with a slot, no horn visible; its shadow is the largest shape on the wall

change.to: [-0.30, 1.05, 0] (back and further from the camera, so the horn shows whole in the upper left behind the cabinet, soft through f/2.8)

changes.expected: The horn's silhouette reads at the upper left as soft context; the left edge of the frame is wall, not a red slab.

changes.problem: The walnut cabinet is soft and low-resolution at this distance.

evidence.measured: front edge lum_range 19.4, grain visibly blurred at 2x crop

changes.expected: Pores and grain lines resolve on the top and edge at 100%.

changes.problem: Low sample count leaves denoiser smear on brass flutes, acrylic and record.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: wavy, painted highlights along every brass flute; blotchy reflections in the platter

changes.expected: Straight, continuous highlights along each flute; clean glass in the acrylic.

changes.problem: The wall is flat CG paint, 40% of the frame with no surface.

change.to: Poly Haven lime plaster / painted plaster texture at real scale (~1.5 m tile), bump 0.2, tinted to #E6E0D6

changes.expected: The wall reads as a real plastered wall with a gentle tonal breathing; slightly darker so the product stands out.

changes.problem: Focus and sharpness on the tonearm, the frame's crispest detail, are soft.

change.to: 4.0 / [0.42, 0.40, 0.80] (focus on the arm base and platter front edge)

changes.expected: Arm, platter rim and label crisp; cabinet front and wall stay soft.

out_of_scope.request: A glossier, more reflective platter/record top so it catches a cleaner highlight
out_of_scope.why: The platter and record material are part of the product; only the light may change
